metadata.title: What if Gojo lost his powers for 24 hours?
metadata.description:
Gojo temporarily loses his technique and must protect students through planning, restraint and collaboration.

Original hypothetical comedy and commentary. Fan-made alternate scenario; events and dialogue are invented, not canon. AI-assisted narration: Kokoro am_michael. Sound effects: Brackeys, public domain.

#Shorts #Anime #WhatIf #JujutsuKaisen

sound_repair_source.distinctive_development: An invented one-day limit removes usual tools; students disagree about rescue; decoy and evacuation replace overpowering; weakness reveals teaching habits.
